062        public boolean shouldShowAtMarket(MarketAPI market) {
063                //if (true) return true;
064                if (!super.shouldShowAtMarket(market)) return false;
065                
066                if (market.getFactionId().equals(Factions.PIRATES)) return false;
067                if (market.getFactionId().equals(Factions.LUDDIC_PATH)) return false;
068                
069                // what we want:
070                // 1) don't show at the same market for a while
071                // 2) randomly don't show at any particular market, 
072                // unless the player hasn't seen any delivery events in a while
073                
074                if (market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(KEY_ACCEPTED_AT_THIS_MARKET_RECENTLY)) {
075                        return false;
076                }
077                
078                regen(market);
079                
080                if (destination == null) return false;
081                
082                if (escrow > 0 && market.isPlayerOwned()) return false;
083                
084                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(KEY_SAW_DELIVERY_EVENT_RECENTLY)
085                                && shownAt != market) {
086                        if (random.nextFloat() > PROB_TO_SHOW) return false;
087                }
088                
089                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY_SAW_DELIVERY_EVENT_RECENTLY, true, 
090                                                                                                                SAW_RECENTLY_DURATION);
091                
092                return true;
093        }

095        @Override
096        protected void regen(MarketAPI market) {
097                //if (this.market == market) return;
098                if (this.market != market) {
099                        playerCargoCap = 0;
100                        playerFuelCap = 0;
101                }
102                
103                this.market = market;
104                random = new Random(seed + market.getId().hashCode());
105                //random = Misc.random;
106                
107                computeData(market);
108                
109                if (destination != null) {
110                        person = createPerson();
111                }
112        }

114        public static class DestinationData {
115                public MarketAPI dest;
116                public CommodityOnMarketAPI comFrom;
117                public CommodityOnMarketAPI com;
118                public float distLY;
119                
120                public boolean fromHasPA = false;
121                public boolean fromHasCells = false;
122                
123                public boolean hasPA = false;
124                public boolean hasCells = false;
125                
126                public boolean illegal = false;
127                
128                public float score = 0;
129                
130                public DestinationData(MarketAPI from, MarketAPI dest, 
131                                                           CommodityOnMarketAPI comFrom, CommodityOnMarketAPI comDest) {
132                        this.dest = dest;
133                        this.comFrom = comFrom;
134                        this.com = comDest;
135                        distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(from.getLocationInHyperspace(), dest.getLocationInHyperspace());
136                        
137                        fromHasPA = from.hasCondition(Conditions.PIRATE_ACTIVITY);
138                        fromHasCells = from.hasCondition(Conditions.PATHER_CELLS);
139                        hasPA = dest.hasCondition(Conditions.PIRATE_ACTIVITY);
140                        hasCells = dest.hasCondition(Conditions.PATHER_CELLS);
141                        
142                        illegal = dest.isIllegal(com.getId());
143                        
144                        score += Math.min(distLY, 10f);
145                        
146                        if (fromHasPA) score += 10f;
147                        if (fromHasCells) score += 5f;
148                        if (hasPA) score += 10f;
149                        if (hasCells) score += 5f;
150                        
151//                      score += (comFrom.getAvailable() + comFrom.getMaxSupply()) * 0.5f;
152//                      score += comDest.getMaxDemand(); 
153                        
154                }
155        }
156        
157        protected void computeData(MarketAPI market) {
158                
159                data = null;
160                destination = null;
161                reward = 0;
162                duration = 0;
163                faction = null;
164                quantity = 0;
165                commodity = null;
166                
167                List<CommodityOnMarketAPI> commodities = new ArrayList<CommodityOnMarketAPI>();
168                for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : market.getCommoditiesCopy()) {
169                        if (com.isNonEcon()) continue;
170                        if (com.isMeta()) continue;
171                        if (com.isPersonnel()) continue;
172                        if (com.isIllegal()) continue;
173                        
174                        if (com.getAvailable() <= 0) continue;
175                        if (com.getMaxSupply() <= 0) continue;
176                        
177                        commodities.add(com);
178                }
179                
180                List<DestinationData> potential = new ArrayList<DestinationData>();
181                
182                float maxScore = 0;
183                float maxDist = 0;
184                for (MarketAPI other : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
185                        if (other == market) continue;
186                        if (other.isHidden()) continue;
187                        if (other.isInvalidMissionTarget()) continue;
188                        
189                        if (other.getEconGroup() == null && market.getEconGroup() != null) continue;
190                        if (other.getEconGroup() != null && !other.getEconGroup().equals(market.getEconGroup())) continue;
191                        
192                        if (other.getStarSystem() == null) continue;
193                        
194                        //WeightedRandomPicker<T>
195                        for (CommodityOnMarketAPI com : commodities) {
196                                //CommodityOnMarketAPI otherCom = other.getCommodityData(com.getId());
197                                CommodityOnMarketAPI otherCom = other.getCommodityData(com.getDemandClass());
198                                if (otherCom.getMaxDemand() <= 0) continue;
199                                
200                                DestinationData data = new DestinationData(market, other, com, otherCom);
201                                if (data.illegal) continue;
202                                if (data.score > maxScore) {
203                                        maxScore = data.score;
204                                }
205                                if (data.distLY > maxDist) {
206                                        maxDist = data.distLY;
207                                }
208                                potential.add(data);
209                        }
210                }
211                if (maxDist > 10) maxDist = 10;
212                
213                WeightedRandomPicker<DestinationData> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<DestinationData>(random);
214                for (int i = 0; i < potential.size(); i++) {
215                        DestinationData d = potential.get(i);
216                        if (d.score > maxScore * 0.5f && d.distLY > maxDist * 0.5f) {
217                                picker.add(d, d.score * d.score * d.score);
218                        }
219                }
220                
221//              Collections.sort(potential, new Comparator<DestinationData>() {
222//                      public int compare(DestinationData o1, DestinationData o2) {
223//                              return (int) Math.signum(o2.score - o1.score);
224//                      }
225//              });
226//              
227//              
228//              WeightedRandomPicker<DestinationData> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<DestinationData>(random);
229//              for (int i = 0; i < potential.size() && i < 5; i++) {
230//                      DestinationData d = potential.get(i);
231//                      picker.add(d, d.score * d.score * d.score);
232//              }
233                
234                DestinationData pick = picker.pick();
235                
236                if (pick == null) return;
237                
238                destination = pick.dest;
239                duration = pick.distLY * 5 + 50;
240                duration = (int)duration / 10 * 10;
241                
242                CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
243                quantity = (int) cargo.getMaxCapacity();
244                if (pick.com.isFuel()) {
245                        quantity = (int) cargo.getMaxFuel();
246                }
247                
248                float pMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_deliveryMissionHighQuantityChanceMult") : 1f;
249                
250                if (random.nextFloat() < PROB_HIGHER_CAPACITY * pMult) {
251                        quantity *= 1f + random.nextFloat() * 3f;
252                        quantity = (int) quantity;
253                }
254                
255                // don't want mission at market to update quantity as player changes their fleet up
256                if (pick.com.isFuel()) {
257                        if (playerFuelCap == 0) {
258                                playerFuelCap = quantity;
259                        } else {
260                                quantity = playerFuelCap;
261                        }
262                } else {
263                        if (playerCargoCap == 0) {
264                                playerCargoCap = quantity;
265                        } else {
266                                quantity = playerCargoCap;
267                        }
268                }
269                
270                quantity *= 0.5f + 0.25f * random.nextFloat();
271                
272                // somewhat less of the more valuable stuff
273                quantity *= Math.min(1f, 200f / pick.comFrom.getCommodity().getBasePrice());
274                
275                int limit = (int) (pick.comFrom.getAvailable() * pick.comFrom.getCommodity().getEconUnit());
276                limit *= 0.75f + 0.5f * random.nextFloat();
277                //if (quantity > 5000) quantity = 5000;
278                if (quantity > limit) quantity = limit;
279                
280                
281                if (quantity > 10000) quantity = quantity / 1000 * 1000;
282                else if (quantity > 100) quantity = quantity / 10 * 10;
283                else if (quantity > 10) quantity = quantity / 10 * 10;
284                
285                if (quantity < 10) quantity = 10;
286                
287                
288                //float base = pick.com.getMarket().getSupplyPrice(pick.com.getId(), 1, true);
289                float base = pick.comFrom.getMarket().getSupplyPrice(pick.comFrom.getId(), 1, true);
290                
291                if (quantity * base < 4000) {
292                        base = Math.min(100, 4000 / quantity);
293                }
294                
295//              float minBase = 100;
296//              if (quantity > 500) {
297//                      minBase = 50;
298//              }
299                float minBase = 100f - 50f * Math.min(1f, quantity / 500f);
300                minBase = (base + minBase) * 0.75f;
301                
302                if (base < minBase) base = minBase;
303                
304                //float extra = 2000;
305                
306                float mult = pick.score / 30f;
307                //if (market.isPlayerOwned() && mult > 2f) mult = 2f;
308                //if (market.isPlayerOwned()) mult *= 0.75f;
309                
310                if (mult < 0.75f) mult = 0.75f;
311                //if (mult > 2) mult = 2;
312                reward = (int) (base * mult * quantity);
313                
314//              float minPerUnit = 50;
315//              if (reward / quantity < minPerUnit) {
316//                      reward = (int) (minPerUnit * quantity);
317//              }
318                
319                reward = reward / 1000 * 1000;
320                if (reward < 4000) reward = 4000;
321                
322                reward += BASE_REWARD;
323                
324                
325                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(KEY_FAILED_RECENTLY)) {
326                        escrow = (int) (quantity * pick.comFrom.getCommodity().getBasePrice());
327                }
328                
329                
330                if (market.getFaction() == pick.dest.getFaction()) {
331                        faction = market.getFaction();
332                } else {
333                        faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
334                        if (faction == null) faction = market.getFaction();
335                }
336                
337                commodity = pick.comFrom.getId();
338                
339                data = pick;
340        }

346        protected void addStoryOption() {
347                String id = "negotiate_id";
348                options.addOption("Negotiate a higher fee for the delivery", id);
349                
350                StoryOptionParams params = new StoryOptionParams(id, 1, "negotiateDeliveryFee", Sounds.STORY_POINT_SPEND_INDUSTRY,
351                                "Negotiated higher fee for delivery of " + data.comFrom.getCommodity().getLowerCaseName() + " to " + data.dest.getName());
352                
353                SetStoryOption.set(dialog, params, 
354                        new BaseOptionStoryPointActionDelegate(dialog, params) {
355
356                                @Override
357                                public void confirm() {
358                                        super.confirm();
359                                        reward = getNegotiatedAmount();
360                                        dialog.getTextPanel().addPara(getNegotiatedText());
361                                        OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
362                                        options.clearOptions();
363                                        options.addOption("Continue", OPTION_CONFIRM);
364                                        //optionSelected(null, OPTION_CONFIRM);
365                                }
366                                
367                                @Override
368                                public String getTitle() {
369                                        //return "Negotiating delivery fee";
370                                        return null;
371                                }
372
373                                @Override
374                                public void createDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info) {
375                                        float opad = 10f;
376                                        
377                                        info.addSpacer(-opad);
378                                        
379                                        info.setParaInsigniaLarge();
380                                        info.addPara("You're able to negotiate the delivery fee from %s up to " +
381                                                        "%s.", 0f, Misc.getHighlightColor(),
382                                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(reward),
383                                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(getNegotiatedAmount()));
384                                        
385                                        info.addSpacer(opad * 2f);
386                                        addActionCostSection(info);
387                                }
388                        
389                });
390        }

392        @Override
393        protected boolean canAccept() {
394                if (escrow <= 0) return true;
395                float credits = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().get();
396                boolean canAfford = credits >= escrow;
397                return canAfford;
398        }

400        @Override
401        protected void doStandardConfirmActions() {
402                CargoAPI cargo = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo();
403                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
404                
405                cargo.addCommodity(commodity, quantity);
406                AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityGainText(commodity, quantity, text);
407                
408                if (escrow > 0) {
409                        cargo.getCredits().subtract(escrow);
410                        AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsLossText(escrow, text);
411                }
412                
413                createIntel();
414        }

477                        "your personal touch. " +

491                } else {
492                        str = "After a brief introduction, " + getHeOrShe() + " wastes no time in getting to the point.\n\n" +

494                           " to %s" + 
495                           ", in the " + data.dest.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType() + ". ";
